published_assets.slope_mask_note: Downloaded and verified separately; the two published masks are byte-identical at this revision, so agreement is a fact about the product rather than a comparison of one local file with itself

independent_recount.source: standard-library read of train_rows.csv and val_rows.csv, not the audit summary
independent_recount.note: The 2026-11-10 review receipt (mmap_linkage_review_01) independently recounts the earlier CSVs; the numbers below were recounted from the final csv schema after the re-execution.

tile_policy.test_geography_bytes: Whole-file SHA256 of the published arrays and the global packed-mask count stream bytes covering every latitude, Test geography included; those bytes are hashed or counted, never decoded into per-tile values for Test, and no Test tile was selected, compared or scored

metadata_cross_check.source: HDF5 metadata group read through the guarded prefix adapter
metadata_cross_check.historical_export_note: The historical metadata export at SHA256 3b3ed8cade200f79f720beeba6a666365d66383dbb623337cd96ebec31a0a98d is not present locally; the audit rebuilt an equivalent table from the HDF5 metadata group and required exact agreement with the pinned archive before using it.

mask_semantics.interpretation: step15 writes packbits(~isfinite) after NaN-to-zero, so zero set bits declare that the published elevation and slope products contain no non-finite pixel anywhere on the grid
mask_semantics.caveat: A finite value is not proof of an un-interpolated measurement; step02 blends SLDEM inside 58 deg, LOLA outside 62 deg with a linear transition and keeps LOLA wherever SLDEM is non-finite

scope.tiff_byte_comparison: NOT_PERFORMED; equality is established against the published z-scored mmap whose pinned builder reads the same GeoTIFF grid

comparison_fields.exact: numerical equality on finite pairs only
comparison_fields.bitwise_exact: identity of the float32 bit pattern on finite pairs only
comparison_fields.beyond: pixels minus within, so NaN and infinity count as beyond
comparison_fields.derived_nonfinite: raw HDF5 window non-finite pixels; must be zero for PASS
